formal_object.required_semantics: Full joint feasible boundary relation, with source-preserving witness reconstruction.

RUP1_distinction.future_question: SINGLE_LITERAL_RUP_IRREDUCIBLE need not imply absence of a stronger exact block-level relation.
RUP1_distinction.explanation: Failure of the frozen one-literal operation does not decide existence or compactness of an interface in another representation language.

future_proof_obligations.name: EXACT_CONTEXTUAL_EQUIVALENCE
future_proof_obligations.statement: For every b: H(b) iff exists u C_U(b,u).
future_proof_obligations.representation_note: If a CNF encoding uses auxiliaries A, define H(b)=exists a Enc(b,a) explicitly; do not silently switch between the encoded formula and its boundary relation.

future_proof_obligations.name: CONSTRUCTIVE_LIFTING
future_proof_obligations.statement: From every accepted boundary assignment/model, construct a compatible internal assignment u and verify it against the complete source block.
future_proof_obligations.cost_note: Specify whether auxiliary witnesses are included in the accepted model; if only boundary values are supplied, any work needed to obtain auxiliaries or internal values must also be counted.

future_proof_obligations.name: NO_OMITTED_SOURCE_CONSTRAINTS
future_proof_obligations.statement: The selected block and its interface must include every applicable original source constraint.

future_proof_obligations.name: DETERMINISTIC_BLOCK_SELECTION_PROVENANCE
future_proof_obligations.statement: Pin the deterministic selector, source identity, chosen block, boundary and all ordering/tie-breaking rules.

future_proof_obligations.name: POLYNOMIAL_CONSTRUCTION_AND_CHECKING_COST
future_proof_obligations.statement: Prove construction, checking, lifting and total attempt/scheduling costs polynomial in original input length for the claimed domain.

future_proof_obligations.name: POLYNOMIAL_INTERFACE_REPRESENTATION_SIZE
future_proof_obligations.statement: Prove a polynomial upper bound on the explicit interface representation size for the claimed input class.
future_proof_obligations.warning: If the chosen exact relation representation needs 2^|B| information in the worst case, semantic correctness does not give a polynomial SAT algorithm.
future_proof_obligations.additional_boundary: Merely retaining hard internal variables as existential auxiliaries is not a demonstrated efficient boundary evaluator or a compact-interface algorithm.

future_proof_obligations.name: NO_HIDDEN_ENUMERATION_OR_ORACLE_OR_BRANCHING
future_proof_obligations.statement: No enumeration, oracle or assignment branching may be hidden behind the term compilation.
